_about: (Rework F4, rounds 52-53 and 69: Hearts of Iron 4's three kinds, decisions only, no combat bonuses) The commanders' traits (Core/Data/CommanderBook, AI/CommanderTraits): personality (up to 2 at the start) and flaw (up to 1 at the start), drawn from the campaign's seed; earned (2 at most) by deeds, a deed's count reaching its threshold; assignable (1 at most, picked by the player once the commander is a Veteran, only for commanders under the player, never changed), unlocked by any of its unlockedBy earned traits (none listed: always open). 'excludes': never drawn together. 'pending': its effect waits for a later package (no effect yet). 'weight': how often drawn (1 by default). 'text': what the player is told (the trait's tooltip). (Rework P8, package T) 'style': the game master's style it gives an ENEMY admiral (AI/EnemyStyle: bold, careful or submariner; same strength and chances, different choices); 'enemyText': the one line an enemy admiral's dossier shows for it once known, in place of 'text'; 'enemyOnly': drawn only for enemy admirals (Submariner), never for the player's commanders nor at the Career setup.

traits.name: Aggressive
traits.text: Fights one stance more boldly than set (Defend as Hold, Hold as Attack). Like every commander, never takes on an enemy below even odds.
traits.enemyText: Bold: opens with combined attacks and air raids.

traits.name: Cautious
traits.text: Fights one stance more carefully than set (Attack as Hold, Hold as Defend) and breaks off for port once any ship is lightly damaged (15 %).
traits.enemyText: Careful: shadows you and waits ahead on your route.

traits.name: Aviation enthusiast
traits.text: Its base's or carrier's air strikes on ships are 50 % larger.
traits.enemyText: Bold: opens with combined attacks and air raids.

traits.name: Missile adherent
traits.text: Closes for missile range: a task force reacts 50 nm farther; a base keeps one combat air patrol pair fewer.
traits.enemyText: Bold: opens with combined attacks and air raids.

traits.name: Logistician
traits.text: Resupplies early: back to port at half fuel or half weapons.
traits.enemyText: Logistician: keeps his groups supplied; no change in how he comes at you.

traits.name: Convoy man
traits.text: Convoys and lanes one place higher in its priorities; as a sector commander, raises a cut lane's escort twice as soon.
traits.enemyText: Convoy man: minds his own shipping; no change in how he comes at you.

traits.name: Career officer
traits.text: Gains experience 25 % faster.
traits.enemyText: Career officer: plays it by the book; no change in how he comes at you.

traits.name: Naval lineage
traits.text: Holds on: breaks off only at odds a quarter lower than its stance allows, never below even (on Defend: at even odds, not 1.2 to 1).
traits.enemyText: Naval lineage: a name to live up to; no change in how he comes at you.

traits.name: Media personality
traits.text: A battle won by its group with a capital ship in it: +1 war will at home.
traits.enemyText: Media personality: seeks the headlines; no change in how he comes at you.

traits.name: Cool head
traits.text: Never chases a contact not yet identified (decoys and feints).
traits.enemyText: Careful: shadows you and waits ahead on your route.

traits.name: Methodical
traits.text: Attacks nothing without a fix less than an hour old.
traits.enemyText: Careful: shadows you and waits ahead on your route.

traits.name: Night fighter
traits.text: Prefers to close and strike at night: a target weighs half as much again between dusk and dawn.
traits.enemyText: Night fighter: at home in the dark; no change in how he comes at you.

traits.name: Weather-wise
traits.text: Uses the weather: no strikes, searches or reconnaissance planned with sea state 6 or more over the base or the carrier (its combat air patrols and interceptions still fly).
traits.enemyText: Careful: shadows you and waits ahead on your route.

traits.name: Opportunist
traits.text: Leaves its area for a weak target (half its strength or less) within 150 nm.
traits.enemyText: Bold: opens with combined attacks and air raids.

traits.name: Submariner
traits.text: An enemy admiral's trait: his answers come more often as submarines.
traits.enemyText: Sends boats: his answers come more often as submarines.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.text: Takes on an enemy at odds 0.2 lower than its stance asks, never below even: on Defend, at even odds instead of 1.2 to 1.
traits.enemyText: Bold: opens with combined attacks and air raids.

traits.name: Hesitant
traits.text: Reacts an hour late: chases an enemy only once it has known of it for an hour.
traits.enemyText: Careful: shadows you and waits ahead on your route.

traits.name: Glory-seeker
traits.text: Goes for capital ships over its priorities: a group with one weighs twice as much.
traits.enemyText: Bold: opens with combined attacks and air raids.

traits.name: Poor planner
traits.text: Resupplies late: back to port only under 20 % fuel.
traits.enemyText: Poor planner: loose plans; no change in how he comes at you.

traits.name: Political
traits.text: Wants to be seen: its chases and break-offs stop the fast-forward (the Needs orders stop).
traits.enemyText: Political: watches his superiors; no change in how he comes at you.

traits.name: Rigid
traits.text: Won't change an impossible mission on its own: tells you, even under a sector commander, and takes no new job from it.
traits.enemyText: Rigid: sticks to his orders; no change in how he comes at you.

traits.name: Old guard
traits.text: Gains experience 25 % slower, and never pursues past its area's border.
traits.enemyText: Old guard: old habits; no change in how he comes at you.

traits.name: Craven
traits.text: Breaks off at odds 25 % better than its stance needs.
traits.enemyText: Careful: shadows you and waits ahead on your route.

traits.name: Caustic
traits.text: Its sector commander sends no other group to help against an enemy within 100 nm of it (unless you order it).
traits.enemyText: Caustic: hard on his staff; no change in how he comes at you.

traits.name: Sea wolf
traits.text: Earned: a submarine group's commander whose boats sank 20,000 t.

traits.name: Hunter-killer
traits.text: Earned: 2 enemy submarines sunk in its battles.

traits.name: Spotter
traits.text: Earned: 10 enemy groups first found by its units.

traits.name: Air controller
traits.text: Earned: 10 air strikes flown from its base or carrier.

traits.name: Fleet protector
traits.text: Earned: 3 battles screening a convoy or a carrier without losing it.

traits.name: Blockade runner
traits.text: Earned: 3 clean break-offs from a stronger enemy.

traits.name: Fly swatter
traits.text: Earned: 20 enemy aircraft shot down in its battles.

traits.name: Superior tactician
traits.text: Earned: 3 battles won against a stronger enemy.

traits.name: Cold water expert
traits.text: Earned: 3 battles north of 55° N.

traits.name: Inshore fighter
traits.text: Earned: 3 battles within 30 nm of land.

traits.name: Blue water expert
traits.text: Earned: 3 battles 90 nm or more from land.

traits.name: Concealment expert
traits.text: Keeps out of sight: on a free hand, its group opens the range from a stronger enemy surface group known within 100 nm.

traits.name: Lone wolf
traits.text: Fights alone: with no other group of ours within 100 nm, takes on an enemy at odds 0.1 lower, never below even (on Defend, 1.1 to 1 instead of 1.2).

traits.name: Silent hunter
traits.text: A submarine group's: reaches convoys and lanes 50 % farther.

traits.name: Flight deck manager
traits.text: Keeps one more combat air patrol pair up when fighters allow.

traits.name: Fighter director
traits.text: Intercepts raids 50 nm farther out.

traits.name: Search pattern expert
traits.text: Flies its searches and recon every 8 h instead of 12.

traits.name: Torpedo expert
traits.text: Submarines weigh half as much again in its priorities.

traits.name: Mine craft
traits.text: Minelaying and clearance (no effect yet: mining comes with a later package).

traits.name: Ground pounder
traits.text: A base or carrier commander with it, on Automatic and not on Defend, flies one strike a day of their own at the enemy rail junction that most starves a fought front in reach.
